# Explore the Extraordinary

* * *

Welcome to the world-famous Needles Landmark Attraction, one of the Isle of Wight’s most iconic sights and a unique part of Britain.

From fun family attractions and our seasonal events offering, to retail outlets, cafés and restaurants, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

[OPENING TIMES](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/plan-your-visit/opening-times/)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Dino Jeep Safari](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/dino-jeep-safari/)

Recently refurbished to a roaring success, our Dino Jeep Safari ride is an experience not be missed for any budding explorer!

[Read More](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/dino-jeep-safari/)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Tea Cups](http://needles.andholdens.agency/attractions/rides\#teaCups)

One of the kids’ favourite rides at The Needles is the Tea Cup Ride! Jump in your very own teacup which spins and whirls around. Spin your wheel to increase the pace or go gentle if you prefer a slower ride. Each cup can take up to 4 people so it’s great fun for all the family.

[Read More](http://needles.andholdens.agency/attractions/rides#teaCups)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Isle of Wight Sweet Manufactory](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/sweet-manufactory/)

During the 19th Century many new sweets were invented including some of today’s much-loved favourites such as candy floss, liquorice allsorts, jelly babies, wine gums and marshmallows. Watch in awe and wonder as our confectioners create sweet treats…

[Read More](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/sweet-manufactory/)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Alum Bay Glass](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/glass-blowing/)

Established in 1972, Alum Bay Glass produces beautiful and unique glassware and offers live demonstrations from our skilled local craftsmen.

[Read More](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/glass-blowing/)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Sand Shop](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/sand-shop/)

Filling a glass shape with layers of different coloured sand from Alum Bay is a long held tradition and fond childhood memory too many.

[Read More](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/sand-shop/)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Chairlift](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/chairlift/)

Always a firm favourite with our visitors, the iconic Needles Chairlift is the best way to see the Isle of Wight’s most famous landmark.

[Read More](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/chairlift/)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Boat Trips](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/boat-trips/)

For a close-up view of the dramatic Needles Rocks and Lighthouse, take one of the pleasure boats\* from the jetty for a dramatic trip around the rocks and lighthouse and panoramic views of the Alum Bay sand cliffs….

[Read More](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/attractions/boat-trips/)

##### ATTRACTIONS

### [Jurassic Adventure Golf](http://needles.andholdens.agency/attractions/rides\#golf)

An absolutely roaring success, our prehistoric Jurassic Adventure Golf course now features a 11-hole course with some 5 and 6 par holes all beautifully set off by imaginative water features and storyboards depicting 11 different dinosaur species.

[Read More](http://needles.andholdens.agency/attractions/rides#golf)

## A must do when visiting Isle of Wight

We visited as a large family group and went on the cables cars down to the beach, this was great fun and we all agreed we would do it again on our next holiday.

Felicity, Truro

![Tripadvisor](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/wp-content/themes/theneedles/library/images/tripadvisor.svg)

## A natural wonder!

What a stunning place, so beautiful in any weather. The views are incredible.

A. Whittall, Hampshire

![Tripadvisor](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/wp-content/themes/theneedles/library/images/tripadvisor.svg)

## A Great Family Day Out!

As we are a big family we bought the supersaver tickets to go on chairlift. This was amazing, I am not good with heights but it was very gentle and the views were stunning. Alum bay is gorgeous, we were lucky with the weather and spent about an hour on the beach...Lovely day out, something you should see if you go to the Isle of Wight

Sarah, Exeter

![Tripadvisor](https://www.theneedles.co.uk/wp-content/themes/theneedles/library/images/tripadvisor.svg)
